description: An updated checkpoint of inclusionAI's Ling 3.1 Flash, provided free of charge by Novita AI until November 3, 2026. Ling 3.1 Flash is a hybrid reasoning mixture-of-experts model with 25B active parameters out of 560B total and a 1M-token context window.
name: inclusionAI: Ling 3.1 Flash 1019 (free)
